script: In 1944, a young American sailor aboard the USS Princeton wrote one final letter home before a kamikaze attack sank his ship in the Pacific. His widow spent the rest of her life believing he died instantly, without pain. She never remarried, and she never stopped grieving quietly. Decades later, a Navy researcher going through declassified war records found something nobody had ever shown her: a full account of his final hours, and proof that his last thoughts were of coming home to her. The Navy tracked down her family and finally delivered the real story, sixty one years after he died. She had spent a lifetime carrying a secret she never knew was incomplete. The truth didn't come too late. It just took the Navy sixty one years to find the right envelope.
